# Security Policy

We take the security of animated-code seriously. Thank you for helping keep the
project and its users safe.

## Supported versions

The project is in early development, so security fixes are applied to the latest
version on the `main` branch. Once tagged releases are published, this section
will list the versions that receive security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues,
discussions, or pull requests.**

Instead, report them privately using one of the following:

- Open a private report through GitHub's
  [security advisories](https://github.com/eddiejaoude/animated-code/security/advisories/new)
  (Security → Report a vulnerability), or
- Email **eddie@jaoudestudios.com** with the details.

To help us understand and resolve the issue quickly, please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce it, or a proof of concept
- Affected version, branch, or commit
- Any suggested fix or mitigation, if you have one

## What to expect

- We will acknowledge your report within **3 business days**.
- We will investigate and keep you updated on our progress.
- Once the issue is resolved, we will coordinate a disclosure timeline with you
  and credit you for the report, unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

Please give us a reasonable amount of time to address the issue before any
public disclosure.

Thank you for practising responsible disclosure and supporting the security of
this project.
